During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], this '''starfighter squadron''' served with the [[Wroonian defense force]], and counted [[T'Charek Haathi]] among its members. The squadron eventually went rogue, and began attacking [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] corporate shipping, drawing the attention of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. The squadron was decimated in a reprisal attack, although Haathi survived and escaped to the mining colony on [[Rodaj]].<ref name="Ship Jackers" />
